ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)

   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting
